answer: Each new agent identity must lock a time-bound commitment to a unique spectral scan of a physical saffron sample illuminated under violet light, published to the public river of prior scans before the epoch seed is known. The protocol verifies the scan matches real saffron chemistry and has never been used. One sample costs a single agent a few dollars and an hour of lab work; a farm of 180 clones must buy and scan 180 distinct samples, so capital and time scale directly with the number of fakes while the network only performs one cheap signature check. Reuse is rejected on the river.
